item.title: First Minister Chooses Highland Landscape for 2025 Christmas Card
item.description: A winter photograph of Loch Ossian taken by First Minister John Swinney has been chosen as his 2025 Christmas card, highlighting the importance of nature, wellbeing and connection during uncertain and challenging times.The post First Minister Chooses Highland Landscape for 2025 Christmas Card appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Suspected Avian Flu Cases Reported Among Geese at Highland Nature Reserve
item.description: Suspected avian flu cases have been reported among geese at a Highland nature reserve, prompting fresh guidance from RSPB Scotland as the risk to wild birds rises across the country this winter.The post Suspected Avian Flu Cases Reported Among Geese at Highland Nature Reserve appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Driving Home for Christmas – Travellers Urged to Plan Ahead as Festive Rush Begins
item.description: Festive travellers are being urged to plan ahead as Scotland’s roads and rail network prepare for the Christmas rush, with gritters ready, extra train services added and Police Scotland advising drivers to allow extra time and drive to conditions.The post Driving Home for Christmas – Travellers Urged to Plan Ahead as Festive Rush Begins appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Tesco Backs Ullapool Pupils With £1,500 Boost for Duke of Edinburgh Award
item.description: Young people in Ullapool are being given the chance to build confidence, skills and community spirit after a £1,500 Tesco grant helped safeguard the Duke of Edinburgh Award at Ullapool High School during a challenging time for rural education.The post Tesco Backs Ullapool Pupils With £1,500 Boost for Duke of Edinburgh Award appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Elgin Rape Case Ends With Nine Year Prison Sentence
item.description: A serious rape case in Elgin has concluded with a 9 year prison sentence, highlighting the lasting impact of sexual violence and the importance of justice, accountability, and support for victims across Moray and the wider Highlands.The post Elgin Rape Case Ends With Nine Year Prison Sentence appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A9 Raigmore Interchange Improvement Works to Start in January 2026
item.description: Roadworks at the A9 Raigmore Interchange in Inverness will begin in January 2026, bringing overnight lane closures and changes aimed at improving safety, traffic flow, and active travel, with drivers encouraged to plan ahead during the four month project.The post A9 Raigmore Interchange Improvement Works to Start in January 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Skye’s The Limit for Junior Master Chefs as Island Restaurant Re-Opens Kitchen Classroom for 2026
item.description: Young pupils on Skye are getting a rare taste of life in a world class kitchen as The Three Chimneys re opens its classroom experience for 2026, blending local produce, education, and community pride while inspiring the island’s next generation of hospitality talent.The post Skye’s The Limit for Junior Master Chefs as Island Restaurant Re-Opens Kitchen Classroom for 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: M&S Brings Sustainable Sprouts to Christmas Tables With Seed to Shelf Farming
item.description: From wildflower planting to hand trimmed produce, a Scottish farm near Arbroath is shaping how M&S grows its Christmas Brussels sprouts, blending biodiversity, climate conscious farming, and long term partnerships to deliver better food while protecting nature.The post M&S Brings Sustainable Sprouts to Christmas Tables With Seed to Shelf Farming appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: No Cheer Keir Puts Premium on Price of Your Pint
item.description: Pubs across Scotland are warning of higher pint prices and potential job cuts after new budget pressures, with industry leaders and SNP politicians urging action to protect local hospitality venues during the Christmas period.The post No Cheer Keir Puts Premium on Price of Your Pint appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Bah Humbug as One in Five Brits Talk to Their Car to Cope With Christmas Chaos
item.description: As Christmas pressure builds, new research shows one in five UK drivers talk to their car to cope with festive stress, highlighting how winter travel, busy roads, and packed schedules turn vehicles into trusted companions during the most chaotic time of year.The post Bah Humbug as One in Five Brits Talk to Their Car to Cope With Christmas Chaos appeared first on The Highland Times.
